zh: 最近看到一个AI落地案例，对我启发特别大。
en: I recently saw an AI implementation case that really inspired me.

zh: 一个学社会学、没有受过专业编程训练的北海道农民，
en: A Hokkaido farmer who studied sociology and had no formal programming training

zh: 怎么把AI真正接进了温室？
en: managed to connect AI to his greenhouses.

zh: 他不是问AI：“你怎么帮我把农场管起来？”
en: He did not ask AI, "How can you run my farm for me?"

zh: 他先说清楚了一个每天都在发生的麻烦。
en: He first described a problem that happened every day.

zh: 这个农场里面有好几座温室，温度一高，
en: The farm had several greenhouses. When temperatures rose,

zh: 工作人员就得一座一座地去看，然后再手动开窗。
en: staff had to inspect them one by one and open the windows by hand.

zh: 于是他就想要一个结果。什么结果呢？
en: So he defined the result he wanted. What was it?

zh: 然后他就问ChatGPT：能不能让大家平时在一个聊天群里面，
en: He asked ChatGPT: Can everyone use their usual group chat

zh: 看到每座温室的温度上升之后，只需要发一句话，就把窗户打开？
en: to see each greenhouse temperature and open a window with one message?

zh: ChatGPT就帮他拆解方案、列部件。
en: ChatGPT broke down the solution and listed the components.

zh: 然后他照着买了温度计、小型控制器和电机。
en: He bought thermometers, small controllers, and motors.

zh: 不会接线，他就把部件拍下来，继续一步一步地问。
en: When wiring confused him, he photographed the parts and kept asking.

zh: Codex再帮他写代码，把传感器、聊天工具和电机接起来。
en: Codex helped write the code linking sensors, chat, and motors.

zh: 然后他自己进到温室里面安装、测试，报错了，回来再继续改。
en: Then he installed and tested it himself, returning to fix every error.

zh: 这套远程开窗，他前后大概做了两个月的时间。
en: The remote window system took him about two months.

zh: 后来员工只需要在群里发一句“温度”，数据就能出来。
en: Later, staff typed "temperature" in the group and the readings appeared.

zh: 发出开窗指令，电机就会动作。
en: A window-open command made the motor move.

zh: 多语言消息转换、手机定位记录农活，也是一点点这样做出来的。
en: Message translation and phone-based field logging were built the same way.

zh: 所以AI在这里干了什么？
en: So what did AI actually do here?

zh: 它没有替农民懂农业，它更像多了一个会写代码、
en: It did not understand farming for him. It acted more like a coding

zh: 会帮忙查错的搭档，把农民脑子里已经说得清楚的现场经验，
en: and debugging partner, turning his clearly expressed field experience

zh: 慢慢变成了能运行的工具。
en: into a tool that could actually run.

zh: 我看到这里，一下子就想到我自己做的三个项目。
en: That immediately reminded me of the three projects I am building.

zh: 一个跟石头有关，一个跟漫展有关，还有一个跟设计师的灵感有关。
en: One involves stones, one a convention, and one a designer’s inspiration.

zh: 看起来离得很远，可它们的起点其实一样。
en: They look unrelated, but they begin in the same place.

zh: 有一群人一直想做一件事，只是被流量、技术或者流程卡住了。
en: A group wants to do something but is blocked by reach, technology, or process.

zh: 先说今石缘。玩石头的人，谁不想把自己的好东西拿出来，让更多人看看？
en: First, Jinshiyuan. Stone collectors want more people to see their best pieces.

zh: 可每个人自己的朋友圈、群和账号流量都有限。
en: But each person’s Moments, groups, and account reach are limited.

zh: 一块好石头发出去之后，可能热闹两天，很快就沉下去了。
en: A fine stone may attract attention for two days, then disappear.

zh: 所以我们想搭一个持续运行的线上石展。
en: So we want to build an ongoing online stone exhibition.

zh: 石友把图片、尺寸、石种和作品故事传来。
en: Collectors submit photos, dimensions, stone type, and the work’s story.

zh: 后台由人工审核，入选之后，系统给它一个独立编号，
en: People review each entry first. Selected works receive a unique number

zh: 再放到线上展厅，后面还能继续被找到。
en: and enter the online gallery, where they remain discoverable.

zh: AI在这里不负责鉴定，也不替人判断石头值多少钱。
en: AI does not authenticate the stone or decide its price.

zh: 它负责根据审核过的原图和真实资料，辅助美化图片，
en: Using approved original photos and factual material, it helps enhance images

zh: 然后整理赏析内容，统一制作展示海报。
en: and organize appreciation copy into a consistent exhibition poster.

zh: 平台再把这些作品发到今石缘的账号、朋友圈和群里，
en: The platform then shares the works through Jinshiyuan’s account, Moments, and groups.

zh: 用平台已有的流量，帮个人的好东西被更多石友看见。
en: Its existing reach helps more collectors discover each person’s best pieces.

zh: 后面每一期，我们还准备做线上评选。
en: In future rounds, we also plan online judging.

zh: 给获奖作品发数字证书，按当期规则设置奖品。
en: Winning works can receive digital certificates and rule-based prizes.

zh: 这样大家不只是来看一眼，而是愿意把全国各地真正喜欢的石头拿出来，
en: The goal is to get collectors nationwide to share pieces they truly love,

zh: 一起展示、一起交流。
en: for exhibition and exchange.

zh: 再看Bo2漫展。卖票、出票、现场验票，这些都是基本功能。
en: Next is the Bo2 convention. Ticket sales, issue, and entry checks are basic functions.

zh: 但一场漫展结束以后，观众真正愿意带走、愿意分享的，往往还有自己当天的照片。
en: After the event, what attendees want to keep and share is often their own photo.

zh: 所以我们要把这两件事接起来。
en: So we want to connect those two experiences.

zh: 观众购票、现场核验入场以后，系统给他一份免费的AI海报积分。
en: After purchase and verified entry, the system gives them free AI poster credits.

zh: 他把当天拍的角色扮演照片上传，选择喜欢的风格。
en: They upload a cosplay photo from the day and choose a visual style.

zh: AI再把这张现场照片做成一张属于他自己的漫展纪念海报。
en: AI turns that real photo into their own convention souvenir poster.

zh: 票证明他真实来过，照片是他的输入，风格由他自己选。
en: The ticket proves they attended; the photo is their input; they choose the style.

zh: AI负责完成中间的视觉转换，周边产品也可以在同一个入口里展示和销售。
en: AI handles the visual change, while merchandise can be shown and sold in the same place.

zh: 还有一个，就是之前我们提到的大志设计师灵感项目。
en: The third is Dazhi’s designer inspiration project, which I mentioned before.

zh: 大志不缺灵感。真正麻烦的是，一个想法冒出来以后，
en: Dazhi does not lack ideas. The real challenge begins when an idea appears:

zh: 怎么尽快把它看见、选定，再一步步推到能沟通、能修改、能继续使用。
en: how to see it, choose it, and develop it into something discussable, editable, and reusable.

zh: 我们把他的文字、草图、平面图或者参考资料留住。
en: We preserve his text, sketches, floor plans, and references.

zh: 整理成灵感卡，再让AI显影出几个真正不同的方向，大志自己选。
en: They become inspiration cards, and AI reveals different directions for Dazhi to choose.

zh: 哪里不对，就继续改。每一次为什么选、为什么删，都留下来。
en: He keeps revising, recording why each option was kept or removed.

zh: 选定以后，还可以往下做不同视角、不同光线、软装和硬装的调整。
en: The chosen direction can be refined through viewpoints, lighting, furnishings, and finishes.

zh: 画面里的家具、灯具和其他元素，也可以继续拆出来单独研究。
en: Furniture, lighting, and other elements can also be separated for further study.

zh: 再往后，施工草图和平面图可以进入效果图、多角度高清图和动画这条深化链。
en: Sketches and floor plans can later feed renderings, multi-angle images, and animation.

zh: 图片想看哪个角度，视频想做四秒、八秒，还是更长一点，都不必从头再来。
en: A new angle or a four-, eight-, or longer video does not require starting over.

zh: 现在已经内部验证过的，是灵感记录、三个方向、连续细化、快速多视角。
en: Internally verified so far: idea capture, three directions, refinement, and rapid multi-view concepts.

zh: 不同长度的概念视频和本地知识回写。
en: We have also tested different video lengths and local knowledge write-back.

zh: 把这三个项目放回北海道那个农场，我现在看得更清楚了。
en: Putting these projects beside the Hokkaido farm makes the pattern clearer.

zh: AI真正有用的地方，不是给原来的页面多加一个“生成”按钮。
en: AI’s real value is not adding another "Generate" button to a page.

zh: 它要接进一条真实的参与过程：谁有需求，谁来提供资料。
en: It must join a real participation chain: who needs it, and who provides the material?

zh: AI具体处理哪一步，最后由谁来确认。
en: Which step does AI handle, and who makes the final decision?

zh: 结果放在哪里，下一次还能不能继续使用。
en: Where does the result live, and can it be reused next time?

zh: 你也可以看看自己最熟的行业。
en: Look at the industry you know best.

zh: 有没有一群人一直想做一件事，却被流量、技术或者流程卡住？
en: Is a group being blocked by reach, technology, or process?

zh: 如果把它做成一条链，哪些事可以交给AI，哪些判断必须留在人的手里？
en: If it became a chain, what could AI handle, and what judgment must remain human?

zh: 我现在做的，就是把这些问题放进一个个本地项目里面去跑。
en: I am testing these questions through one local project at a time.

zh: 如果这期视频对你的行业有所启发，评论区留下你的行业和你想解决的问题，我给出方案。
en: If this inspires your industry, comment with your field and problem. I will offer a direction.

zh: 关注我，我是超哥。我在兰州搞AI创业。
en: Follow me. I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
